note: Corps of Engineers campground on a wooded J. Percy Priest Lake peninsula near La Vergne, about 15 miles from downtown Nashville, with a boat ramp; no swim beach. --Claude
summary: Poole Knobs (USACE, active - 2027 season May 3-Sep 23 on rec.gov): 78 sites, 47 with 50A+water, to 40 ft; showers/dump. Lakeview checked hard and KEPT: shore loops (32-38, 42-52, 56-64) sit 12-30 m from the summer-pool line, 1.5-4.5 m above it, but every pad is behind a 12-20 m shrub/tree band. Fees $24-36 unchanged.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakeview' kept after a hard check. Closest pads to the summer-pool line (490 ft = 149.4 m): site 59 (36.055027,-86.520289) ~12 m and ~1.9 m above; 60 (36.054823,-86.520036) ~16 m, ~1.9 m; 32 (36.058471,-86.518207) ~14 m, ~1.5 m; 50 (36.057521,-86.521535) ~20 m, ~3.4 m; 52 ~24 m; 62 ~27 m; 48 ~30 m, ~4.2 m. The bank is gentle enough for the kayak test at 59/60/32, but on leaf-off Esri imagery each pad sits behind a 12-20 m band of trees and brush that would be closed in summer, and no pad opens onto the shore - a view, not lakefront. Not an upgrade.
FEES unchanged: rec.gov rate table (2026 and 2027 seasons) still $36 electric / $24 non-electric for standard sites; multi-family electric codes $32/$45 and group $50 not counted.
SITES: rec.gov's description says '87 shady and spacious campsites' (site numbers run to 87) but the catalog holds 78; count 78 kept.
PIN fine: stored 36.05640,-86.51750 = the site-point centroid.
Phone 615-459-6948 and website unchanged. Facility active (2027 rate season posted).
